source.name: MIT OpenCourseWare 18.085 Lecture 31 video
source.licenseNote: MIT OCW materials use a Creative Commons BY-NC-SA style license; keep media in local cache and verify terms before redistribution.

replay.prepareNote: The script downloads the Internet Archive MP4, SRT subtitle, and derivative thumbnails when missing. Large media stays under .local and is not committed.

expectedQuestions: 这段视频里老师讲了什么重点？
刚才视频和音频合起来说明了什么？
能不能给我看一下对应的视频证据？

releaseGate.minimum: Evidence must expose at least one video artifact, linked keyframe, and transcript-ready audio window under hostModelVideoMode=keyframes.
releaseGate.target: Review/evidence should answer from transcript plus keyframe/OCR, not only from the still image summary.
